svg.title: Distributed Job Execution Engine - Proposed AWS Production Architecture
svg.desc: AWS deployment architecture with EKS-hosted Job and Worker services, Dapr sidecars, PostgreSQL outboxes, Redis pub-sub, and managed observability.
svg.text: Proposed AWS production topology • reliable commands, transactional outbox, leases, retries, idempotency, and recovery
Target production deployment • local demo remains MiniStack + Docker Compose
Amazon VPC • private subnets across two Availability Zones
Kubernetes deployments • replicas, probes, disruption budgets, and autoscaling
Dapr service invocation: claim / renew lease / cancel check

g.text: IRSA + CSI driver; no app keys
Proposed target; not the current MiniStack topology
